$schema-comment: Codified base settings applied to every Mossworks-Labs repo by .github/workflows/apply-repo-settings.yml. PATCH /repos/{owner}/{repo} accepts the keys in `settings`. To change behaviour for the whole org, edit + open a PR; the change applies on push to main. Per-repo overrides should be rare — add an entry to `exclude_repos` for repos that need to deviate.
